cases.sentence: Горе вам, беззаботным на Сионе, и вам, кто в Самарии чувствует себя в ___.
cases.translation: Woe to those who are at ease in Zion and to those who are secure on the mountain of Samaria.
cases.explain: The phrase 'в' (in) requires the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Пойдите в Халне и посмотрите на ___.
cases.explain: The preposition 'на' (at) requires the accusative case.

cases.translation: Are they better than these two kingdoms?
cases.explain: The genitive case is used after the number 'двух' (two) to show quantity.

cases.sentence: Вы лежите на кроватях, украшенных слоновой костью, нежитесь на своих ___.
cases.translation: You lie on beds of ivory and stretch yourselves on your couches.
cases.explain: The preposition 'на' (on) with location requires the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Вы питаетесь лучшими игнятами и упитанными ___.
cases.translation: You eat the fatted calf and the best lamb from the flock.
cases.explain: The verb 'питаетесь' (eat) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Вы пьете вино чашами, мажетесь лучшими благовониями, но не горюете о крушении ___.
cases.translation: You drink wine in bowls and anoint yourselves with the best oils, but you are not grieved over the affliction of Joseph.
cases.explain: The preposition 'о' (about) requires the prepositional case, but the English uses genitive forms.

cases.sentence: Я гнушаюсь гордостью Израиля. Крепости его мне ___.
cases.translation: I abhor the pride of Jacob and detest his fortresses.
cases.explain: The predicate adjective 'ненавистны' agrees with the subject 'Крепости' in nominative.

cases.sentence: Я отдам город врагам со всем, что есть в ___.
cases.translation: I will deliver up the city with all that is in it.
cases.explain: The preposition 'в' (in) requires the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Горе вам, беззаботным на Сионе, и вам, кто в Самарии чувствует себя в безопасности.
reading.question: Who is being condemned in this verse?
options: The carefree and secure wealthy of Zion and Samaria
reading.correct: The carefree and secure wealthy of Zion and Samaria
reading.explain: The verse pronounces woe on those who are 'беззаботные' and 'чувствует себя в безопасности'.

reading.ru: Вы, знати первого из народов, которым приходят израилетяне.
reading.question: Who are being addressed?
options: The notable men of the chief of nations
reading.correct: The notable men of the chief of nations
reading.explain: The verse refers to 'знати первого из народов' — the notable men of the chief of the nations.

reading.ru: Вы лежите на кроватях, украшенных слоновой костью, нежитесь на своих ложах.
reading.question: What luxury is described in this verse?
options: Lying on beds of ivory and stretching on couches
reading.correct: Lying on beds of ivory and stretching on couches
reading.explain: The verse depicts 'лежите на кроватях, украшенных слоновой костью' — lying on beds decorated with ivory.

reading.ru: Вы горланите под звуки арфы и думаете, что сочиняете песни, как Давид.
reading.question: What are these people doing?
options: Singing and making music like David
reading.correct: Singing and making music like David
reading.explain: The verse says 'Вы горланите под звуки арфы' — You sing loudly to the harp like David.

reading.ru: Поэтому вы среди первых пойдете в плен, и кончится ликование изнеженных.
reading.question: What will happen to these luxurious people?
options: They will be among the first to go into captivity
reading.correct: They will be among the first to go into captivity
reading.explain: The verse declares 'вы среди первых пойдете в плен' — You will go into captivity among the first.

reading.ru: Скачут ли лошади по скале? Пашут ли там навалах? Вы же превратили правосудие в яд и плод праведности в горечь.
reading.question: What has Israel turned justice into?
reading.explain: The verse says 'превратили правосудие в яд и плод праведности в горечь' — turned justice into poison and righteousness into bitterness.
